datasets: parallel corpus for Japanese spoken-to-written style conversion (CJSW)
outputs: Generated written-style text from spoken-style input
Generated standard Japanese text from dialect input

changes_made.explanation: Removed tasks mentioned only in introduction (Machine Translation, Image Captioning) since they are not actually evaluated. Removed duplicate dialect dataset names and kept only the main corpus names. Consolidated model names to their canonical forms and removed specific fusion method variants (those are techniques, not distinct models).
Normalized metric variants to their base forms as per guidelines (BLEU-3 → BLEU, ROUGE-L → ROUGE)
No LLM-as-judge evaluation conducted in this paper. GPT is used as external language model for generation, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation mentioned in the paper, only automatic metrics are used for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on text style conversion tasks using Transformer models with external language model fusion. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some items from the introduction that weren't part of the actual experiments. The paper only uses automatic evaluation metrics, no human or LLM-based evaluation.
